trustedProxies.title: Trusted proxies
trustedProxies.label: Reverse proxies in front of this instance
trustedProxies.help: One address per line: your reverse proxy's own address (such as 127.0.0.1 on the same machine). Never a network or a Docker gateway.
trustedProxies.none: Empty: no proxy is trusted. Forwarded headers are ignored and the visitor's address is the one of the connection.
trustedProxies.invalid: Not an IP address or network (an address, or address/prefix; at most /8 for IPv4, /16 for IPv6; no ::ffff: form): {{entries}}
trustedProxies.saveFailed: Could not save the trusted proxies
trustedProxies.broadEntry: Risky entry: {{entries}}. List only the proxy's own address.
trustedProxies.httpsNotTrusted: The HTTPS proxy in front of Meshloom is not trusted yet: add its address here.

errors.auth_trusted_proxies_invalid: Not an IP address or network, a network wider than /8 (IPv4) or /16 (IPv6), or more than 32 trusted proxies

login.untrustedProxy: The proxy in front of Meshloom is not trusted yet. An administrator can add it in Settings → Local Configuration → Trusted proxies.
